clusters.headline: Taiwan Residents Head To Polls For Critical Local Elections
aiSummaryBullets: Polling stations have opened across Taiwan for citizens to elect local mayors and other government officials.
The mayoral race in Taipei serves as a significant indicator for the governing Democratic Progressive Party against the opposition.

clusters.headline: Chiang Wan-an Secures Re-Election As Taipei Mayor In Tight Race
aiSummaryBullets: Chiang Wan-an of the Kuomintang defeated Puma Shen in the Taipei mayoral election.
Puma Shen of the Democratic Progressive Party conceded the election results.
